desks.name: Financial and Investment
desks.strapline: Capital Raising | Investment Placement | Deal Origination
desks.description: FIBD connects capital to opportunity. The division works with businesses seeking funding and with investors seeking credible, well prepared opportunities to deploy into, and it does the unglamorous work in between: preparing the information memorandum, testing the numbers, and making sure both sides are looking at the same set of facts before a term sheet is drafted.
focus_areas: Debt and equity capital raising for SMEs, corporates and project sponsors
Investor identification, screening and introduction
Preparation of information memoranda, teasers and investor packs
Securities placement and capital markets introductions
Fund sourcing for public sector and development projects
Financial modelling, valuation support and deal structuring advice

desks.name: Insurance and Reinsurance
desks.strapline: Risk Placement | Cover Design | Claims Advocacy
desks.description: Insurance is bought badly far more often than it is bought well. IRBD represents the client, not the underwriter, and that distinction shapes everything the division does. We assess exposure first, design the cover around the actual risk profile, then take the programme to the market and negotiate on price and terms.
focus_areas: Risk audit, exposure mapping and cover gap analysis
General, life, health and group scheme placement
Construction all risks, contractors plant and erection all risks
Marine, aviation, cargo and goods in transit cover
Agricultural, index based and parametric insurance
Reinsurance placement and facultative arrangements
Claims preparation, negotiation and settlement advocacy

desks.name: Business Sales, Mergers and Acquisitions
desks.description: BMAD is business brokerage in its classic form. The division represents owners selling all or part of a business, buyers looking for a going concern, and families working through succession where the next generation is not ready or not interested.
focus_areas: Business valuation and saleability assessment
Confidential marketing and buyer screening
Mergers, acquisitions, divestments and management buyouts
Joint venture and strategic partnership brokerage
Succession and exit planning for owner managed businesses
Due diligence coordination and completion management

desks.name: Debt, Trade Finance and Structured Credit
desks.strapline: Working Capital | Trade Instruments | Debt Restructuring
desks.description: Many otherwise sound businesses fail on liquidity rather than on strategy. DTFD sources and structures the credit that keeps trade moving, from invoice discounting and receivables finance to letters of credit, guarantees and bonds.
focus_areas: Working capital, overdraft and term loan placement
Letters of credit, bank guarantees, bid and performance bonds
Invoice discounting, factoring and receivables finance
Asset finance and lease brokerage
Debt restructuring, refinancing and settlement negotiation
Supply chain and distributor finance arrangements

desks.name: Real Estate and Property
desks.description: REPD handles the sale, purchase, letting and management of residential, commercial, industrial and institutional property. The division is built on a simple commitment: we do not market a property whose title we have not examined, and we tell clients what we find.
focus_areas: Residential and commercial sales and purchase brokerage
Office, retail, warehouse and industrial lettings
Title verification, searches and documentation support
Rental valuation, market appraisal and pricing advice
Property and facilities management arrangements
Sale and leaseback and investment property placement
Diaspora property acquisition and custodial services

desks.name: Construction, Infrastructure and Project
desks.strapline: Project Matching | Contractor Sourcing | PPP Facilitation
desks.description: CIPD draws directly on the firm's built environment heritage. The division brings together project sponsors, contractors, consultants, financiers and public authorities, and structures the commercial relationships that allow an infrastructure project to actually reach financial close.
focus_areas: Contractor, consultant and subcontractor sourcing and matching
Project sponsorship, equity participation and consortium formation
Public private partnership and concession facilitation
Tender identification, bid partnering and prequalification support
Project finance introduction and sponsor investor matching
Contract negotiation support and commercial structuring

desks.name: Land, Agricultural Estates and Agribusiness
desks.description: Land is the asset most often mishandled and most frequently litigated. LAAD brokers land transactions with a strong emphasis on customary process, verified documentation and stakeholder consent, working with families, stools, skins and statutory bodies as the situation requires.
focus_areas: Land identification, assembly and acquisition brokerage
Customary land negotiation with traditional authorities
Title search, documentation and registration facilitation
Agricultural estate, plantation and concession transactions
Outgrower, nucleus farm and offtake partnership brokerage
Agribusiness investment matching and venture structuring

desks.name: Plant, Equipment and Machinery
desks.strapline: Capital Equipment | Plant Hire | Asset Disposal
desks.description: PEMD sources, places and disposes of capital equipment. Whether a contractor needs an excavator for a nine month contract, a processor needs a production line, or an insolvent operation needs its assets converted to cash, the division handles the search, the verification and the commercial terms.
focus_areas: New and used plant and machinery sourcing
Construction, mining and agricultural equipment brokerage
Plant hire, leasing and short term equipment placement
Industrial and processing line procurement
Asset disposal, auction coordination and salvage sales
Equipment valuation, inspection and condition reporting

desks.name: Commodity and Produce
desks.description: CPBD matches producers, aggregators, processors and buyers across the agricultural value chain. The division brokers spot sales, forward contracts and structured offtake agreements in cocoa, cashew, shea, grains, oil palm, poultry, fish and horticultural produce.
focus_areas: Producer to processor and processor to buyer matching
Spot, forward and structured offtake contract brokerage
Export commodity placement and international buyer sourcing
Quality, grading and certification coordination
Aggregation, warehousing and storage arrangements
Price discovery, market intelligence and contract administration

desks.name: Mining, Minerals and Natural Resources
desks.description: MMND operates in a sector where regulation, community relations and technical verification determine whether a transaction is sound. The division brokers concession interests, joint ventures, service contracts and mineral offtake, always within the licensing framework and always with attention to host community obligations.
focus_areas: Mining concession and licence interest brokerage
Joint venture, farm in and partnership structuring
Mineral offtake and refinery placement arrangements
Mining services, contractor and supplier matching
Quarry, aggregate and industrial minerals transactions
Regulatory, licensing and community engagement facilitation

desks.name: Energy, Power and Petroleum
desks.description: EPPD works across conventional and renewable energy. The division brokers power purchase arrangements, independent power project partnerships, solar and mini grid installations, fuel supply contracts and distribution agreements.
focus_areas: Independent power project partnering and sponsor matching
Power purchase and energy supply agreement facilitation
Solar, mini grid and distributed generation brokerage
Petroleum product supply, bulk distribution and haulage contracts
LPG, biomass and alternative fuel arrangements
Energy efficiency retrofit and performance contract brokerage

desks.name: Carbon, Climate and Environmental Markets
desks.strapline: Carbon Credits | Climate Finance | Environmental Assets
desks.description: CCED is the firm's newest and fastest growing practice. The division brokers carbon credits, project development rights and climate finance across voluntary and compliance markets, and it advises sellers on how to reach an investable standard before they approach buyers.
focus_areas: Carbon credit origination, aggregation and sale
Voluntary and Article 6 compliance market placement
Climate finance and green fund introduction
REDD plus, reforestation and clean cookstove project brokerage
Plastic credit, waste recovery and circular economy transactions
Verification, registry and benefit sharing coordination

desks.name: Freight, Shipping and Logistics
desks.description: FSLD arranges the movement of goods. The division brokers freight capacity across road, sea, air and rail, negotiates rates, matches shippers with carriers, and coordinates the warehousing and last mile arrangements that complete a delivery.
focus_areas: Road, sea, air and multimodal freight brokerage
Vessel, vehicle and aircraft chartering arrangements
Container, bulk and project cargo placement
Warehousing, bonded storage and distribution arrangements
Freight rate negotiation and framework contracting
Cold chain and specialised cargo handling

desks.name: Import, Export and Trade Facilitation
desks.strapline: Cross Border Trade | Customs | Market Entry
desks.description: IETD helps Ghanaian businesses sell abroad and helps foreign businesses buy and sell here. The division sources counterparties, negotiates trade terms, and manages the documentary and customs process that trips up so many first time exporters.
focus_areas: Export buyer sourcing and international market entry support
Import supplier identification, vetting and negotiation
Customs clearance, documentation and compliance facilitation
AfCFTA and regional trade opportunity brokerage
Distributorship, agency and representation agreements
Trade mission, buyer delegation and exhibition coordination

desks.name: Hospitality, Tourism and Events
desks.description: HTED brokers hospitality assets and hospitality services. On the asset side the division handles hotel and lodge sales, leases, management contracts and franchise arrangements. On the services side it places conference business, group accommodation, catering contracts and event venues.
focus_areas: Hotel, guest house, lodge and resort sales and leases
Hotel management contract and brand affiliation brokerage
Restaurant, bar and catering business transactions
Conference, banquet and event venue placement
Group accommodation, travel and tour package brokerage
Tourism asset investment matching and operator sourcing
Hospitality staffing, supply and service contract brokerage

desks.name: Human Capital and Talent
desks.strapline: Executive Search | Contract Staffing | Workforce Supply
desks.description: HCTD places people. The division runs executive searches, supplies contract and project based labour, and manages outsourced workforce arrangements for clients who need capacity without permanent headcount.
focus_areas: Executive search and senior appointment brokerage
Professional, technical and skilled trades recruitment
Contract, project and seasonal labour supply
Managed outsourcing and payroll arrangements
Expatriate placement, permits and relocation coordination
Credential verification, referencing and background checks

desks.name: Education, Training and Student Placement
desks.description: ETSD connects learners with institutions and institutions with each other. The division places students in local and international programmes, brokers scholarship and sponsorship opportunities, and arranges partnerships between schools, universities and training providers.
focus_areas: Local and international study placement and admissions support
Scholarship, bursary and sponsorship brokerage
Institutional partnership, affiliation and franchise arrangements
Corporate training provider sourcing and matching
Internship, attachment and graduate placement brokerage
Education asset transactions including school sales and leases

desks.name: Health, Medical and Wellness Services
desks.strapline: Medical Referral | Health Assets | Equipment Supply
desks.description: HMWD brokers arrangements across the health sector, from medical referral and treatment abroad to the sale of clinics and the supply of equipment and consumables.
focus_areas: Medical referral and treatment abroad facilitation
Clinic, pharmacy, laboratory and diagnostic centre transactions
Medical equipment, device and consumable supply brokerage
Corporate health scheme and HMO placement
Health investment and facility development partnerships
Wellness, fitness and care service contracting

desks.name: Technology, Intellectual Property and Innovation
desks.strapline: IP Licensing | Technology Transfer | Digital Assets
desks.description: TIPD brokers knowledge and the rights attached to it. The division licenses intellectual property, arranges technology transfer between research institutions and industry, and matches software, platforms and digital businesses with buyers and investors.
focus_areas: Patent, trademark and intellectual property licensing
Technology transfer and commercialisation of research
Software, platform and digital business transactions
ICT infrastructure, hardware and systems procurement brokerage
Innovation partnership and research collaboration matching
Domain, data and digital asset transactions

desks.name: Media, Advertising and Sponsorship
desks.description: MASD sits between brands and the platforms that reach audiences. The division negotiates media buying arrangements, brokers sponsorship and endorsement deals, and structures brand partnerships across broadcast, print, outdoor and digital channels.
focus_areas: Media buying, airtime and advertising space negotiation
Sponsorship, naming rights and endorsement brokerage
Outdoor, billboard and experiential placement
Digital, influencer and content partnership arrangements
Production, creative and agency service sourcing
Media asset and station transaction brokerage

desks.name: Transport, Automotive, Marine and Aviation
desks.description: TAMD brokers moving assets. The division handles fleet acquisition and disposal, commercial vehicle sourcing, vessel and boat transactions, and aircraft charter and acquisition arrangements.
focus_areas: Fleet acquisition, replacement and disposal brokerage
Commercial vehicle, bus and haulage unit sourcing
Vehicle leasing, hire purchase and rental arrangements
Marine vessel, boat and barge transactions
Aircraft charter, lease and acquisition facilitation
Vehicle inspection, valuation and documentation verification

desks.name: Franchise, Licensing and Distribution
desks.description: FLDD brings established brands into new territories and helps local brands expand through structured replication. The division brokers franchise rights, master licences, territory agreements and exclusive distributorships.
focus_areas: Franchise and master franchise rights brokerage
Territory licensing and area development agreements
Exclusive and non exclusive distributorship arrangements
Brand licensing and merchandising agreements
Franchisee assessment, matching and onboarding support
Franchise system development for expanding local brands

desks.name: Art, Luxury and Collectible Assets
desks.description: ALCD serves collectors, estates and institutions. The division brokers fine art, sculpture, antiquities, jewellery, precious stones and other collectible assets, with attention to provenance, authentication and lawful export.
focus_areas: Fine art, sculpture and contemporary African art transactions
Provenance research, authentication and condition assessment
Jewellery, precious stone and precious metal brokerage
Collection valuation, insurance and estate advisory
Auction representation and private treaty sales
Export permit and cultural property compliance support

desks.name: Sports and Entertainment
desks.description: SEBD represents athletes, artistes and rights holders in commercial negotiations. The division brokers transfers, contracts, image rights, sponsorship and touring arrangements, and advises young talent on the commercial realities behind an offer.
focus_areas: Athlete transfer, contract and representation brokerage
Artiste booking, touring and performance contracting
Image rights, endorsement and sponsorship negotiation
Broadcast and event rights placement
Club, academy and franchise investment matching
Career, welfare and commercial advisory for young talent

desks.name: Diaspora Investment and Remittance
desks.strapline: Diaspora Capital | Trusted Representation | Homeland Investment
desks.description: DIRD exists because distance breeds risk. Ghanaians abroad routinely lose money on projects and purchases at home for want of a trustworthy representative on the ground.
focus_areas: Diaspora property acquisition, construction supervision and custody
Business and franchise investment matching for returnees
Verified project sourcing and independent due diligence
Local representation, agency and progress reporting
Remittance linked investment and savings product introduction
Return and resettlement transaction support

advisers.name: Prof. Ernest Ofori Asamoah
advisers.qualifications: PhD, MSc, MA, MBA, BSc, MCIM-UK, CMC
advisers.profile: Senior Associate, KPMG Global Consulting, and Adjunct Professor, University of Johannesburg. Over fifteen years in research and consulting across finance and investment. He oversees capital raising, investor placement and deal structuring, and sits on the board as a director.

advisers.name: Prof. Douglas Boateng
advisers.qualifications: PhD, MSc, BSc, FCILT, FCIPS, FIoD
advisers.profile: Industrialist and supply chain governance specialist with extensive board level experience across mining, manufacturing and public institutions. He advises on commodity, freight, logistics and value addition mandates, and on the industrial strategy questions that sit behind large offtake arrangements.

advisers.name: Rev. (Prof.) Joseph Ignatius Teye Buertey
advisers.portfolio: Engineering, Cost Verification and Technical Assurance
advisers.profile: Professor of construction and civil engineering. He is responsible for technical condition assessment, cost verification and engineering assurance across infrastructure, plant and property mandates, and signs off the engineering opinions the firm presents to clients.

advisers.name: Prof. Eric Oduro-Ofori
advisers.profile: Associate Professor in the Department of Planning at KNUST and a local government, planning and monitoring and evaluation consultant. He advises on assembly mandates, land use questions and public private transaction structuring, and manages the firm's relationships with district and municipal authorities.

advisers.name: Prof. Richard Ohene Asiedu
advisers.profile: Professor of construction management with a research record in project cost performance and delivery risk. He leads equipment specification, inspection and valuation, and advises on the disposal of plant and infrastructure assets where condition and residual value are contested.

advisers.name: Prof. Francis Kwesi Bondinuba
advisers.profile: Housing finance and construction economics specialist. He advises on housing delivery mandates, affordable housing partnerships and the diaspora investment desk, where his work on housing finance informs how the firm structures and supervises builds for clients living abroad.

advisers.name: Prof. Emmanuel Adinyira
advisers.profile: Professor in the Department of Construction Technology and Management at KNUST, with a research focus on sustainability in the built environment. He assesses carbon projects for additionality, permanence and benefit sharing before the firm takes them to buyers, and advises on climate finance mandates.

advisers.name: Dr. Frank Boateng
advisers.qualifications: PhD, MPhil, MBA, MPM, BSc, ICIA, CFM, CMgr FCMI
advisers.profile: Senior Lecturer at the University of Mines and Technology, Tarkwa, and a Chartered Management Consultant. He advises on concession interests, mining services mandates, licensing and host community obligations, and applies the firm's rule that no resource mandate proceeds without demonstrable lawful title and permitting.

advisers.name: Dr. Kenneth Appiah Donkor-Hyiaman
advisers.portfolio: Real Estate, Land and Housing Finance
advisers.profile: Economic growth, land economy and planning consultant. He sets the valuation basis on property mandates and advises on land assembly, title risk and real estate investment structuring, including the customary land questions that decide whether a transaction completes or litigates.

advisers.name: Dr. Ernest Kissi
advisers.portfolio: Project Delivery and Public Private Partnerships
advisers.profile: Construction project management and value management specialist in the Department of Construction Technology and Management at KNUST. He advises on project structuring, delivery risk and concession arrangements, and leads the firm's work on consortium formation for large works.

advisers.name: Dr. Michael Adesi
advisers.profile: Lecturer in the Department of Construction Technology and Management at KNUST. He advises on contractor assessment, prequalification, consortium formation and the commercial structuring of construction mandates.

advisers.name: Dr. Christian Sewordor Mensah
advisers.profile: Lecturer at Accra Metropolitan University and a Chartered Management Consultant. He advises on produce aggregation, offtake structuring, agricultural estate transactions and agribusiness investment matching, and on the quality and grading standards that determine whether an export contract holds.

advisers.name: Dr. Ralph Nyadu Addo
advisers.profile: Senior Lecturer in the Department of Publishing Studies at KNUST and a mindset transformation trainer with over twenty five years in entrepreneurship and training. He advises on media buying, sponsorship, brand partnership and publishing rights mandates.

advisers.name: Dr. Maxwell Wahabu Manpaya
advisers.profile: Responsible for procurement process integrity, tender and contract review, and the internal audit standards applied to mandate files and client fee accounting. His function sits deliberately outside the desks that earn the fees.

advisers.name: Rev. (Dr.) Nanayaa Tina Owusu-Prempeh
advisers.profile: Responsible for business valuation, saleability assessment, confidential buyer screening and family succession mandates, where the commercial and the personal are rarely separable and both need handling.

advisers.name: Rev. (Mrs.) Angela Carmen Appiah
advisers.profile: Responsible for mandates across the hospitality, training, placement and human services desks, and for the firm's client care and ethical conduct standards.

advisers.name: Dr. Emmanuel Asare
advisers.portfolio: Corporate Finance and Financial Due Diligence
advisers.profile: Responsible for accounts review, financial verification and the evidential basis of every valuation the firm presents to a client.

advisers.name: Dr. Alexander Acheampong
advisers.profile: Responsible for independent power project partnering, power purchase facilitation, fuel supply and bulk distribution mandates.

advisers.name: Dr. Dramani Apour
advisers.profile: Responsible for market studies, price discovery, sector analysis and the research evidence that supports transaction pricing across all twenty five desks.

advisers.name: Ms. Susana Asamoa, Esq.
advisers.profile: Responsible for title investigation, contract review, conveyancing oversight and the legal integrity of completion documentation. Her appointment brings in house the verification standard on which the firm's title commitments rest.

advisers.name: Mr. Alexander Baah Amoakwa
advisers.profile: Responsible for risk audit, cover design, insurance market placement and claims advocacy conducted on the client's behalf rather than the underwriter's.

advisers.name: Mr. Bright Agyeman Adu
advisers.profile: Responsible for freight capacity sourcing, carrier and rate negotiation, warehousing arrangements and the customs and documentary process behind import and export mandates.

directors.name: Prof. De-Graft Owusu-Manu
directors.profile: Professor of Construction Technology and Management at KNUST and a Chartered Management Consultant with over two decades in project finance, infrastructure economics, research and business advisory. He leads the firm's transaction strategy and carries personal responsibility for its capital markets, infrastructure and carbon practices.

directors.name: Prof. Ernest Ofori Asamoah
directors.qualifications: PhD, MSc, MA, MBA, BSc, MCIM-UK, CMC
directors.portfolio: Director and Lead Adviser, Financial and Investment Brokerage
directors.profile: Senior Associate at KPMG Global Consulting and Adjunct Professor at the University of Johannesburg, with more than fifteen years in research and consulting across finance and investment. He joined the board bringing the capital markets relationships on which the firm's fund raising mandates depend, and continues to lead the financial and investment desk.

directors.name: Mrs. Matilda Owusu-Manu
directors.profile: Management and human development specialist responsible for corporate governance, statutory compliance and administration, and for the firm's human capital and services brokerage practices.
